title: Ring Shared-User Access Summary
app: Reolink, UniFi Protect, Ring, Nest Protect, Frigate, and Home Assistant security integrations streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT, webhooks, and vendor APIs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ring:event event=user_access
| stats dc(user) as users, count as events by device
| where users>2
| sort - users
description: Uses Ring access logs telemetry to monitor which devices are being touched by many household users in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for shared-access surfaces that deserve a quick review, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Ring access logs data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Device table of unique users and access events.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which devices are being touched by many household users so you can spot shared-access surfaces that deserve a quick review before it becomes annoying.
